logline: 황무지 저택의 주인이 문 앞에서 죽은 채 발견되고, 그 곁에 남은 자국이 사람의 것이 아니다.
destination: 황무지 한복판의 늪 — 밤마다 울음소리가 나는 자리
setting: 19세기 말 잉글랜드 데번 황무지, 저택과 늪과 돌무더기
anchor: a solid middle-aged doctor in a tweed travelling suit and bowler, moustached, bleak Dartmoor moorland
palette: fog white-grey, peat black, heather purple, thin lantern yellow

beats.beat: 의사가 안개 낀 황무지 역에 내려선다.
beats.visual: a middle-aged doctor stepping from a small station platform into rolling moorland fog, cart waiting
beats.motion: fog rolls across the platform, the cart pony stamps, his hat brim drips

beats.beat: 저택 문 앞에서 그는 낯선 자국을 발견한다.
beats.visual: a doctor crouching with a lantern over large paw prints in wet earth before a stone gateway
beats.motion: his lantern lowers over the prints, mud glistens, mist creeps across the ground

beats.visual: a doctor standing at a lit window looking out over black moorland, curtains pulled wide
beats.motion: the curtain lifts in the draught, his hand flattens on the glass, fog moves outside

beats.visual: a ragged man scrambling behind granite boulders on a moonlit ridge, candle stub falling from his hand
beats.motion: he scrambles over the rock, the candle drops and rolls, wind scours the ridge

beats.visual: a doctor stooping into a low stone hut on the open moor, ash and a folded blanket inside
beats.motion: ash lifts from the cold fire, the blanket shifts, light enters behind him

beats.visual: a moor pony sinking into black bog water, reeds parting around it, two men running from a ridge
beats.motion: bog water closes over the reeds, the men run downhill, birds burst upward

beats.beat: 안개 속에서 커다란 형체가 달려 나온다.
beats.visual: a huge dark hound shape bursting out of thick fog across the moor, faint glow along its jaws
beats.motion: the shape charges out of the fog, heather flattens, lantern beams jerk sideways

beats.beat: 그 짐승은 정말 이 세상의 것일까?
beats.visual: a doctor standing with a raised lantern in swirling fog, a low shape circling at the light's edge
beats.motion: the lantern arm rises, fog wheels around him, the shape crosses the beam

withheld: 짐승의 정체와 부린 자가 늪에서 맞는 마지막
